intent: Create a new original 3D chibi brand mascot for the KursoKo Filipino career-guidance web app. Stylized vinyl-toy 3D render with bold black outlines — NOT photorealistic, NOT soft NPR without outlines. Original design — not a copy of any existing game, IP, or prior image.

output.framing: full body, head to both shoes, small padding at top and sides, feet near bottom edge
output.background: fully transparent — no floor, no studio backdrop, no gradient, no shadow blob on ground

render_style.aesthetic: stylized chibi vinyl toy / mobile-game mascot — toon-shaded 3D with ink outlines
render_style.engine_look: Blender Freestyle outline + toon BSDF, or Unreal Engine stylized toon avatar with post-process edge detection
render_style.shading_model: toon-shaded / cel-shaded hybrid — flat color bands on skin and clothing, NOT smooth photoreal gradients
render_style.materials: matte vinyl toy skin, matte fabric hoodie, matte rubber sneaker soles, matte plastic tablet — zero subsurface scattering, zero skin pores

edge_treatment.style: clean consistent bold BLACK ink-style outlines on full silhouette and major internal features
edge_treatment.weight: uniform medium stroke — visible at thumbnail size
edge_treatment.coverage: character perimeter, eyes, mouth, hair facet edges, clothing seams, shoe stripe, tablet edges
edge_treatment.critical: outlines are NON-NEGOTIABLE — shapes must NOT be defined by lighting alone

anti_realism_rules.skin: flat matte vinyl toy surface — 2-tone max shading (base + soft shadow). NO subsurface scattering, NO pore texture, NO realistic jaw sculpt, NO human portrait lighting
anti_realism_rules.eyes: flat cartoon eyes — solid dark brown iris fill, 2 white circular catchlights only. NO iris gradient, NO cornea refraction, NO realistic eye depth, NO eyelid fold detail
anti_realism_rules.overall: must read as 3D game mascot or vinyl figure — NOT AI portrait, NOT uncanny valley human

must_not_look_like: realistic eyes with depth and gradient iris
watercolor or soft AI illustration slop

failed_generation_anti_patterns.description: Traits from a failed v3 regen that MUST be avoided
avoid: no black outlines — shapes defined only by soft lighting
realistic medium-tan skin with jawline sculpt and soft portrait shading
eyes with gradient iris, cornea depth, and realistic specular — looks like human not mascot
head turned straight toward camera instead of three-quarter left
body angled 45° right while face looks at viewer — wrong direction
faint nose shadow suggesting a bridge — nose must be completely absent
smooth hair without visible low-poly facets

proportions.head_to_body_ratio: oversized head roughly 2.5× torso height — classic chibi mascot scale
proportions.limbs: short arms and legs, rounded chunky hands with four visible fingers, compact feet

pose.stance: standing relaxed, weight evenly on both feet, feet slightly apart
pose.body_orientation: three-quarter view — torso turned toward viewer's LEFT
pose.head_direction: face turned toward viewer's LEFT in three-quarter profile — NOT facing camera straight-on
pose.right_arm: bent at elbow, hand curled into loose fist resting against lower chin — classic thinking gesture
pose.left_arm: forearm folded across lower chest, holding tablet vertically against torso
pose.head_tilt: very slight tilt, attentive and calm
pose.expression_energy: quiet confidence — deciding a career path, not worried

skin_tone.rendering: flat matte vinyl — maximum 2 tone bands (base + soft shadow). Toy figure paint, NOT human skin shader

eyes.shape: large perfectly round cartoon eyes — flat graphic shapes on 3D head
eyes.color: solid flat dark brown #3D2314 iris — uniform fill, NO gradient
eyes.highlights: exactly two white circular catchlights per eye (upper-left glossy dots)
eyes.pupils: same dark brown as iris or simple black dot — no realistic depth
eyes.lashes: minimal — single dark upper lash line outlined in black, no heavy mascara
eyes.spacing: wide friendly spacing, eyes in lower half of face
eyes.forbidden: realistic iris gradient, cornea refraction, wet-eye look, human eye anatomy, eyelid crease detail

face.eyebrows: thick dark brown curved brows #2C1810 outlined in black, slightly raised outer ends — thoughtful not angry
face.mouth: small gentle closed smile — single short black-outlined curved line, no lip geometry
face.cheeks: optional very faint flat blush — no realistic blush gradient
face.nose: ABSENT — no nose geometry at all. Smooth uninterrupted flat skin plane between eyes and mouth. No nostrils, no nose bridge, no nose shadow, no nose line, no dot, no faint bridge shadow
face.ears: large rounded cartoon ears protruding at head sides, same flat skin tone, simple inner-ear C curve, black outline

hair.color: dark chocolate brown #2C1810 base with lighter brown #4A3228 facet highlights on plane tops
hair.style: messy short layered cut, blocky geometric fringe
hair.geometry_critical: hair MUST read as LOW-POLY 3D SCULPT — large flat angular geometric planes, chunky triangular and trapezoid facets with hard plane breaks and black outlines on facet edges. Mobile game character mesh look
hair.must_not_be: soft flowing anime strands, painted illustration locks, wispy Ghibli hair, smooth sculpted hair without visible facets

hoodie.fit: loose, dropped shoulders, long sleeves bunched slightly at wrists
hoodie.hood: down, resting on upper back — hood outline visible behind neck
hoodie.drawstrings: two thin cream strings with small metal aglets at chest
hoodie.kangaroo_pocket: single large front pouch seam, subtle
hoodie.fabric: matte cotton fleece, flat toon shading in folds — not photoreal fabric

left_sleeve_logo.position: outer left upper arm only — viewer's right when facing character
left_sleeve_logo.shape: small six-point star or sun burst
left_sleeve_logo.size: about 2cm at scale — small accent, not a large patch

pants.details: minimal — single center seam line per leg, slight stack/fold at ankles above shoes

shoes.sole: thick white rubber platform sole #F0F0F0, about 2cm visible height
shoes.accent: one horizontal sky-blue stripe #42A5F5 across outer side of each shoe
shoes.laces: white flat laces, tied in simple bow

prop_tablet.object: plain rectangular tablet device — like a small iPad
prop_tablet.color: dark gunmetal grey #3A3A3A body, slightly lighter grey #555555 screen bezel
prop_tablet.screen: blank dark grey glass — no icons, no text, no UI, no glow
prop_tablet.orientation: portrait vertical, held against left side of torso under folded arm
prop_tablet.must_not_be: clipboard, paper pad, checklist, notebook, book, phone, laptop

lighting.key_light: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45 degrees
lighting.fill: gentle ambient fill — flat toon bands, not portrait lighting
lighting.shadows: simple flat shadow bands in hoodie folds only — not realistic ambient occlusion
lighting.silhouette_read: comes from black outlines first, rim light second

forbidden_in_image: text or logos except orange sleeve emblem

Thinking pose facing left, tablet under left arm, cream hoodie with orange sun on left sleeve, navy pants, white sneakers with blue stripe. Transparent background.
visual_reference_description.silhouette: chunky chibi outline with visible black ink perimeter — big round head, wide hoodie shoulders, narrow ankles, sneakers at bottom

prompt:
Create an original 3D chibi brand mascot for Filipino career-guidance app KursoKo. New original design, not any existing game or copyrighted character.

STYLE — CRITICAL: 3D toon-shaded vinyl toy mascot with BOLD BLACK INK OUTLINES on full silhouette, eyes, mouth, hair facets, clothing seams, and props. Blender Freestyle / toon-shader look. Flat cel-shaded color bands — NOT photorealistic, NOT soft NPR without outlines, NOT Pixar realistic skin.

SKIN: flat matte vinyl toy surface warm light tan #E8B896 — max 2 tone bands, zero pores, zero subsurface scattering, zero realistic jaw sculpt. Toy figure paint job.

EYES: large perfectly round flat CARTOON eyes — solid flat dark brown #3D2314 iris with NO gradient, exactly 2 white circular catchlights per eye. NO cornea depth, NO realistic iris, NO wet human eye look. Black outline around each eye.

NOSE: COMPLETELY ABSENT — smooth flat skin between eyes and mouth. Zero nose geometry, zero nostrils, zero nose shadow, zero faint bridge shadow.

HAIR: dark chocolate brown low-poly FACETED 3D sculpt — large angular geometric planes, chunky triangular facets with black outlines on edges. Mobile game mesh hair. NOT smooth sculpted hair, NOT anime strands.

PROPORTIONS: chibi super-deformed — head 2.5× torso, short limbs, full body head to sneakers, age 17-22 slim student.

POSE: standing three-quarter view — body AND face turned toward viewer's LEFT (not facing camera). Right hand fist under chin thinking gesture. Left forearm across chest holding dark grey rectangular tablet vertically (iPad shape, blank screen, NOT clipboard, NOT laptop).

OUTFIT: oversized cream #F5F0E6 pullover hoodie hood down, kangaroo pocket, drawstrings, small bright orange six-point sun on LEFT upper sleeve only. Dark navy #1E2A4A straight-leg pants. White sneakers thick white sole, one horizontal sky-blue stripe per shoe.

LIGHTING: soft upper-left studio light, flat toon shadow bands — not portrait lighting.

BACKGROUND: transparent PNG, character isolated. No floor, no shadow blob, no scenery.

OUTPUT: 1024×1365 portrait, professional app marketing quality.
